item.title: Explicit quasi-periodic solutions to the discrete derivative nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation
item.description: arXiv:2610.31347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasi-periodic solutions to the discrete derivative nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation are investigated. A Lax pair of the discrete integrable equation is derived, by which we obtain a nonlinear integrable symplectic map. Resorting to this map, the Riemann theta function expressions for discrete potentials are calculated. Consequently, we get the explicit solutions for the discrete derivative nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation, whose quasi-periodic properties are illustrated through the cases of genus one and genus two.
item.dc:creator: Xiaoxue Xu, Wei Liu, Junyi Zhu

item.title: On Borodin-Gorin presentation of Heckman-Opdam $\mathfrak{gl}_n$ hypergeometric function
item.description: arXiv:2610.30304v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that Borodin-Gorin presentation for Heckman-Opdam $\mathfrak{gl}_n$ hypergeometric function by interlacing integrals is equivalent to two other integral presentations studied in arXiv:2508.18864. We also consider related Baxter operators and the corresponding limiting procedure from the Ruijsenaars hyperbolic model.
item.dc:creator: L. Cherepanov, S. Khoroshkin

item.title: Rational limit of Rains integrals of type $A_n$
item.description: arXiv:2610.30317v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We deduce the rational analogue of the elliptic Rains identity of type $A_n$ arXiv:0309252. We also derive reductions of the rational analogue and present the connection of them with well-known integrals in literature.
item.dc:creator: L. Cherepanov

item.title: Surface Defects in the $\mathcal{N}=2$ Lens Space Index and Elliptic Integrability
item.description: arXiv:2610.30849v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We determine the surface-defect difference operators of the 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ lens space index for class $\mathcal{S}$ theories of type $A_{N-1}$ on $(\mathbb{S}^3/\mathbb{Z}_r)\times\mathbb{S}^1$. For generic fugacities $(p,q,t)$ and arbitrary rank $N$, orbifold order $r$ and discrete holonomies, their coefficients are finite products of theta functions with nomes $p^r$ and $q^r$. After an explicit gauge transformation, Gaussian in the holonomies, each operator factorizes into two elliptic Ruijsenaars--Schneider-type operators with step $pq$, one with nome $p^r$ and one with nome $q^r$, acting on variables glued along a lattice. Using this factorization and a Wronski-type relation, we prove that all the operators commute. We also establish a sufficient criterion for self-adjointness with respect to the bilinear vector multiplet pairing. It applies to the basic mixed operator and, in suitable parameter chambers, to the pure $p$- and $q$-type operators; for general mixed operators the contour prescription remains open. These results support the expectations from S-duality.
item.dc:creator: Masahito Yamazaki

item.title: Quantum K-structure constants and cylindric Grothendieck polynomials for Grassmannians
item.description: arXiv:2610.31607v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We use the partition functions of a five-vertex exactly solvable lattice model from statistical mechanics to give new combinatorial formulae for the Schubert structure constants of torus-equivariant quantum K-theory rings of Grassmannians. The proofs build on our earlier results where we identified the transfer matrices of these lattice models geometrically as multiplications by the Hirzebruch $\lambda_y$ classes of the tautological subbundle and the (dual) quotient bundle. The structure constants are solutions of a system of linear equations with coefficients given by the partition function. This system may be solved explicitly by specializing the Hirzebruch parameter $y$ to an equivariant parameter, leading to explicit formulae using Cramer's rule. Furthermore, we give an alternative combinatorial construction of the partition functions in terms of sums over cylindric set-valued tableaux, which we call cylindric Grothendieck polynomials. The latter generalise McNamara's factorial skew Grothendieck and Yeliussizov's modified Grothendieck polynomials and can be thought of as an equivariant K-theoretic version of Postnikov's toric Schur function. We also provide new polynomial representatives for equivariant K-theory classes of Richardson varieties and their variants.
item.dc:creator: Vassily Gorbounov, Christian Korff, Leonardo C. Mihalcea

item.title: The gauge action on semi-discrete Lax representations, its invariants, and Lax-Miura type constructions
item.description: arXiv:2604.20830v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce and study explicit invariants with respect to the action of (local) gauge transformations on the set of semi-discrete (differential-difference) matrix Lax representations (MLRs) for a given (1+1)-dimensional evolutionary differential-difference equation with any number of components. Using these invariants, we obtain the following general results: - Sufficient conditions for nonremovability of parameters in semi-discrete MLRs. (Nonremovability by means of gauge transformations.) - Necessary conditions for two semi-discrete MLRs to be gauge equivalent. Effective use of these results is demonstrated. We present the general theory and apply it to MLRs for equations of Volterra--Yamilov, Cherdantsev--Yamilov, Toda types and Miura-type modifications. Also, we present a comparison with results of S. Yu. Sakovich and M. Marvan on gauge invariants for (continuous) zero-curvature representations of partial differential equations. Furthermore, we demonstrate procedures for constructing Miura-type transformations (MTs) for discrete (partial difference) equations (on the two-dimensional integer lattice) by means of gauge simplifications of discrete matrix Lax pairs (DLPs) and reductions of auxiliary systems associated with DLPs. This allows us to construct new MTs for (non-evolutionary) 4-point and 6-point discrete equations from [D. Levi, R.I. Yamilov, J. Phys. A 2009], [S. Konstantinou-Rizos, A.V. Mikhailov, P. Xenitidis, J. Math. Phys. 2015].
item.dc:creator: Sergei Igonin
